name: Lucia Fernández
education: B.S. in Software Engineering, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid
summary: Junior-to-mid iOS developer with 2 years of experience building SwiftUI-first apps in Swift. Comfortable shipping screens and wiring up Combine and Core Data, though she has not yet built UIKit interfaces or applied the MVVM pattern in a production codebase.
strengths: Hands-on with Combine for reactive data flows
Uses Core Data for local persistence
Familiar with Xcode tooling and app store submission
gaps: No production UIKit experience; mostly SwiftUI-only
Has not applied the MVVM pattern in a real codebase
resumeText: iOS Developer at Harbor Mobile, shipping SwiftUI screens backed by Combine and Core Data. At Nimbus Apps I started as a junior, owning small features and learning the app release process. I am currently working on moving toward MVVM and gaining UIKit experience to round out my iOS toolkit.
